svg.title: Check a detail through a connector
svg.desc: A connector lets the helper read a service your account is allowed to use. Test the connection with one known document. Prepare. Put Window B on line one of the practice Shift card. Request. Ask for that line using the connected service. Verify. Open the document yourself. Check the file title and the wording.
svg.text: Check a detail through a connector
A connector lets the helper read a service your account is allowed to use.
Test the connection with one known document.
Put Window B on line one of the practice Shift card.
Ask for that line using the connected service.
Open the document yourself. Check the file title and the wording.
